2609.35308.title: Epistemic Policy Divergence in Multi-Turn LLM Contamination: A Protocol-Gradient Investigation
2609.35308.paper_summary: Large language models process conversation history as unverified context: false premises injected into prior turns can be adopted as fact, a failure mode we term session-level contamination. We introduce five contamination protocols arranged along a source-authority gradient, isolating distinct failure mechanisms while holding the false premise constant, and evaluate GPT-5.4 Mini, Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite, and GLM-4.5-Air across ten knowledge domains at temperature zero (22,500 turns), using a dual-track automated judge validated against a human gold standard (Cohen's \k{appa} = 0.901). GPT-5.4 Mini showed zero adoptions across all 500 sessions, a content-independent policy at the session level; token-level probing shows the underlying margin, while large, is finite. Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite followed a steep authority gradient: 0.1% adoption for self-attributed falsehoods, 23.5% for user-cited sources, 68.2% for system-injected authority, and 94.0% under instruction override. GLM-4.5-Air showed a shallower gradient (15.8% vs 84.2%), a 68-percentage-point dissociation confirming that authority deference and instruction compliance are distinct mechanisms within one architecture. Recovery also diverged: GLM recovered in 94.5% of affected sessions, whereas 26.1% of affected Gemini sessions never did, rising to 40.0% under instruction override. Conversation history is an untrusted attack surface requiring provenance-aware system design; the complete framework is released as an open-source benchmark.
2609.35308.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型將對話歷史視為未經驗證的上下文：先前回合中注入的錯誤前提可以被當作事實接受，我們稱之為會話級污染的失敗模式。<lb/>我們介紹了五種污染協議，這些協議沿著來源權威的梯度排列，隔離不同的失敗機制，同時保持錯誤前提不變，並評估 GPT-5.4 Mini、Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite 和 GLM-4.5-Air 在十個知識領域中的表現，溫度設為零（22,500 回合），使用雙軌自動評判，並與人類金標準進行驗證（Cohen's \k{appa} = 0.901）。<lb/>GPT-5.4 Mini 在所有 500 次會話中顯示零採納，這是一種在會話層級上的內容獨立政策；令牌級的探測顯示出潛在的邊際，雖然很大，但仍是有限的。<lb/>Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite 遵循陡峭的權威梯度：自我歸因的虛假陳述採納率為 0.1%，用戶引用來源為 23.5%，系統注入的權威為 68.2%，而在指令覆蓋下則為 94.0%。<lb/>GLM-4.5-Air 顯示出較淺的梯度（15.8% 對 84.2%），68 個百分點的解離確認了權威尊重和指令遵從是同一架構內的不同機制。<lb/>恢復情況也有所不同：GLM 在 94.5% 的受影響會話中恢復，而受影響的 Gemini 會話中有 26.1% 從未恢復，在指令覆蓋下上升至 40.0%。<lb/>對話歷史是一個不受信任的攻擊面，需要具備來源意識的系統設計；完整框架作為開源基準釋出。
